description: This file defines the base class 'VertexBase' for interfacing with Google Cloud Vertex AI and related models. It handles authentication, URL construction for API calls, token retrieval and refresh logic, and utility methods for accessing various configuration parameters related to Vertex AI. The class consolidates complex credential management, endpoint URL formulation, and provides methods to support different LLM providers and model endpoints.

classes.name: VertexBase
classes.description: A base class providing authentication management, URL construction, and utility functions for interacting with Google Cloud Vertex AI and associated models. It manages credentials lifecycle, constructs API endpoints, handles token refresh, and supports different model providers and configurations.

methods.name: None __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the VertexBase class, setting up credential and request handler attributes.

methods.name: str get_vertex_region(self, vertex_region: Optional[str], model: str)
methods.description: Determines the appropriate region for Vertex AI, defaulting to 'us-central1' unless the model is global-only.

methods.name: Tuple[Any,str] load_auth( self, credentials: Optional[VERTEX_CREDENTIALS_TYPES], project_id: Optional[str] )
methods.description: Loads credentials from various formats (file path, dict, environment) and handles different credential types such as external accounts, authorized users, and service accounts, returning credentials object and project ID.

methods.description: Creates AWS-based identity pool credentials with optional scope setting.

methods.name: _credentials_from_authorized_user(self, json_obj, scopes)

methods.name: _credentials_from_default_auth(self, scopes)

methods.name: str get_default_vertex_location(self)
methods.description: Returns the default region 'us-central1'.

methods.name: str get_api_base( self, api_base: Optional[str], vertex_location: Optional[str] )

methods.name: str create_vertex_url( vertex_location: str, vertex_project: str, partner: VertexPartnerProvider, stream: Optional[bool], model: str, api_base: Optional[str] = None, )
